Diagnosis:
CAUSE: HPA `shop/search` is pinned at its maximum of 3 replicas because the Deployment `shop/load` runs three busy-loop `wget` clients against `http://search`, pushing the search pods' CPU to about 180% of their request.

EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop hpa search`: Metrics show `cpu on pods (as a percentage of request): 180% (18m) / 50%`, Min replicas 1, Max replicas 3, and the condition `ScalingLimited: True, TooManyReplicas: the desired replica count is more than the maximum replica count`.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab top -n shop pods` (via diag-k8s): each search pod uses 16–21m CPU against a 10m CPU request, while load pod `load-55fdc5b776-cdjh2` uses 500m.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop deployment search load` (via diag-k8s): the load container runs `for i in 1 2 3; do (while true; do wget -q -O /dev/null http://search; done) & done; wait`, with a 500m CPU limit. The search Deployment has 3/3 replicas available with no restarts.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop load-55fdc5b776-cdjh2 --tail=20` (via diag-k8s): repeated `wget: can't connect to remote host (10.96.19.158): Connection refused`, so the loop keeps firing at the search Service.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop hpa search` (my own check): event `SuccessfulRescale` at 2m37s, `New size: 3; reason: cpu resource utilization (percentage of request) above target`, after earlier `FailedGetResourceMetric` events while pods were unready.

FIX (not applied): Scale the load generator to zero, `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab scale -n shop deployment load --replicas=0`, so the search pods' CPU drops below the 50% target.

Fact.Name: source
Fact.Value: the load comes from the Deployment `load`, which calls `search`

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: raise `maxReplicas` within bounds, or the CPU request; or stop the load if it is not legitimate
